```{r}
#PHASE 4
#Risk Score Model

library(glmnet)
library(randomForest)
library(xgboost)

#Clean Modeling Data Set

risk_df <- nri %>%
  mutate(RISK_SCORE = as.numeric(RISK_SCORE)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(RISK_SCORE))

# Remove ID variables
risk_df <- risk_df %>%
  select(-STATE, -STATEABBRV, -COUNTY, -STCOFIPS)

# Remove prohibited predictors (EAL = losses)
risk_df <- risk_df %>%
  select(-contains("EAL"))

# Keep only numeric predictors
risk_df <- risk_df %>%
  select(where(is.numeric))

# Remove numeric columns with >20% NA
risk_df <- risk_df %>%
  select(where(~ mean(is.na(.)) < 0.20))

# Replace remaining NA with 0 (FEMA convention)
risk_df[is.na(risk_df)] <- 0

# Remove zero-variance cols
risk_df <- risk_df %>%
  select(where(~ var(.) > 0))

# Prepare X and y
X_risk <- as.matrix(risk_df %>% select(-RISK_SCORE))
y_risk <- risk_df$RISK_SCORE

cat("FINAL SHAPE X_risk: ", dim(X_risk)[1], " rows x ", dim(X_risk)[2], " cols\n")


#LASSO

set.seed(123)
lasso_risk <- cv.glmnet(X_risk, y_risk, alpha = 1)

lasso_coef <- coef(lasso_risk, s = "lambda.min")
print(lasso_coef)


#RF

library(dplyr)

set.seed(123)
rf_risk <- randomForest(
  x = X_risk,
  y = y_risk,
  importance = TRUE,
  ntree = 500
)

#Extract importance
rf_imp <- importance(rf_risk)

rf_imp_df <- data.frame(
  variable = rownames(rf_imp),
  IncMSE = rf_imp[, "%IncMSE"],
  row.names = NULL
)

rf_top <- rf_imp_df %>%
  arrange(desc(IncMSE)) %>%
  dplyr::slice(1:15)

print(rf_top)


ggplot(rf_top, aes(x = reorder(variable, IncMSE), y = IncMSE)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Top 15 Predictors of RISK_SCORE (Random Forest)",
    x = "Variable",
    y = "% Increase in MSE"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)


#XGBOOST MODEL

# Convert to xgb.DMatrix
dtrain <- xgb.DMatrix(data = X_risk, label = y_risk)

set.seed(123)
xgb_model <- xgboost(
  data = dtrain,
  nrounds = 200,
  max_depth = 4,
  eta = 0.05,
  subsample = 0.8,
  colsample_bytree = 0.8,
  objective = "reg:squarederror",
  verbose = 0
)

#Var Importance
xgb_imp <- xgb.importance(model = xgb_model)
xgb.plot.importance(xgb_imp[1:15, ])

print(xgb_imp[1:20, ])


#Summary Table

risk_results <- list(
  lasso_top = lasso_coef,
  rf_top15 = rf_top,
  xgb_top20 = xgb_imp[1:20, ]
)

risk_results
```
